sources.shortCitation: USC Digital Library — “Blue Venetian Waters, 1937” [sheet music, pp. 1 & 6 only]
sources.fullCitation: Jurmann, Walter (composer), Kahn, Gus (lyricist), and Kaper, Bronisław (composer). “Blue Venetian Waters, 1937” [sheet music, pp. 1 & 6 only]. Original publisher: Robbins Music Corporation; digital publisher: University of Southern California Libraries. USC Digital Library, unique identifier UC17189702; call number PMC 5/10; legacy identifier kaper-sheet-510-partial; filename kaper-sheet-510-partial.pdf; publisher number SH 1572-4. DOI 10.25549/pmc_09-03-2026_11-05-25_PM-oUC17189702.
sources.title: Blue Venetian Waters, 1937 [sheet music, pp. 1 & 6 only]
sources.creator: Walter Jurmann (composer); Gus Kahn (lyricist); Bronisław Kaper (composer)
sources.repository: University of Southern California Digital Library
sources.researchNote: USC gives 1937 as both creation and issue year; the structured date records the issue year. The asset’s Description field incorrectly names “All God’s Chillun Got Rhythm”, whereas its Core Title, inherited title, call number PMC 5/10 and publisher number SH 1572-4 identify “Blue Venetian Waters”. The preserved cover itself reads “Blue Venetian Waters” and credits Gus Kahn, Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. The citation follows the item identifiers and cover, not the mismatched Description field. Only pages 1 and 6 are available online.
